purpose: Independent N-body truth calibration of the E59/E61 density-to-velocity sign reconstruction. This is a method-calibration gate, not an eBOSS-specific transfer calibration and not an Einstein-Vlasov amplitude prediction.

dataset.rationale: A complete periodic box with halo positions and peculiar velocities; z=1 is close to the eBOSS z~0.95 reconstruction epoch. Used only to truth-calibrate the reconstruction method.

tracer_definition.policy: exactly the 165107 most massive FoF halos
tracer_definition.provenance: Quijote public halo-statistics documentation lists Ntot=165107 for the fiducial z=1 halo sample.
tracer_definition.weights: unit number weights; no mass weighting in the primary test

reconstruction.kernel: same top-hat-smoothed real-space 1/r^2 vector kernel as E59
reconstruction.reason_no_randoms: complete periodic box has no angular/radial selection mask

probes.selection: deterministic without-replacement subset of the fixed tracer sample
probes.truth: FoF halo peculiar velocity GroupVel*(1+z), km/s

primary_metrics.pearson: reconstructed component versus true halo peculiar-velocity component
primary_metrics.sign_agreement: fraction with matching nonzero component sign

if_pass: Advance only to an end-to-end survey/lightcone truth-transfer test. Do not open observed galaxies or observed odd.
if_fail: Do not use the survey-derived velocity tag for observations; revisit reconstruction assumptions before any observational access.
forbidden: retuning R=16 or 192/256 cutoffs after seeing truth
changing tracer count after seeing truth
mass weighting as a rescue of the primary gate
inverse covariance, p-values or detection significance
